ini_comment: Enhancements unique to NCO (not found in original game)
comment: Toggles for new features and enhancements to the game engine.

rules.name: AStarPathFinding
rules.comment: Use an A* path finding algorithm to move units around the map; less dumb and more logical than original method used in C&C. Ported from the CFEPatch - see: https://bitbucket.org/cfehunter/cncremastered/src/cfepatch/

rules.name: RallyPoints
rules.comment: Barracks, Hand of Nod, Weapons Factory etc. support setting rally points for produced units TS/RA2 style. Ported from the CFEPatch - see: https://bitbucket.org/cfehunter/cncremastered/src/cfepatch/

rules.name: CommandoGuard
rules.comment: Allow the commandos to guard an area (applies to any infantry equipped with a RIFLE weapon)

rules.name: MaxBuildDistance
rules.comment: This controls how far away from an existing structure a player can place a building. _Note: values higher than 6 may cause performance problems._

rules.name: ModernWalls
rules.comment: Two wall pieces are connected automatically when placed in line of sight of each-other and walls can be built further away. To ensure balance, when enabled you cannot place buildings beside walls (see ModernWallsAllowBuildings).

rules.name: ModernWallsAllowBuildings
rules.comment: Can the player place buildings beside wall pieces when ModernWalls is on?

rules.name: ModernWallsFullCost
rules.comment: When connecting two wall pieces, should the player pay for each piece of connecting wall? Requires ModernWalls to be on

rules.name: ModernWallsMaxLength
rules.comment: How far apart are two wall pieces allowed to be to allow them to be connected? Respects MaxBuildDistance and [Game.Map]->AllowBuildingBesideWalls

rules.name: CommandoGuard
rules.comment: Allow the commandos to guard an area (applies to any infantry equipped with a RIFLE weapon)

rules.name: NewSaveGameFormat
rules.comment: Use the new JSON save game format for cross-platform, backwards compatible and mod friendly saves. Note disabling this will use the old binary save format, which doesn't support save/load of Scenario Rules or Lua Scripts.
